notes.title: Parachronism Update and Bug Fixes v1.1.1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=https://www.youtube.com/watch?pt0-C625sEE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello peeps!

Over the past two months, Raylea Village has gone through a big renovation. And now, we present you with a whole new freshly-designed Raylea Village. This new design brings you a smoother, lighter and overall happier experience!

Not only a newly designed village, this update also comes with other enhanced gameplay system such as the [b]animal system[/b], [b]daily life interaction[/b] and [b]minor control and bug fixes[/b]. More updates are on the way! Stay tuned!

Psstt! The Myriade Kingdom wants to rearrange its city too!
Now now, have a bright day!

- The NinjaVault Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Small Updates for v1.0.2
notes.content:
We've got some feedback about the game controls that are confusing and not convenient. We hear you, so here we are with the fixes and updates mostly focusing on the game controls and some of the display problem. Below is the list of this update:

1. Basic movement is now using [b]WASD[/b] instead of the arrow keys.
2. You can now enable [b]Mouse Control[/b] for character movement in the Settings menu. By enabling this option, you can move the character by clicking on the ground instead of using WASD.
3. Pressing 'A' or 'D' will immediately moving the character to the left or right instead of just rotating.
4. There's a control guide option on the top right screen (the '?' button).
5. Basic Attack (Punch) is now using '0' instead of 'A'

Have a nice day!
The Ninja Vault Team

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes for v1.0.1
notes.content:
Some players may have found minor bugs in the game. Worry not, Parachronism is just updated to version 1.0.1 to fix minor bugs and here's the list:

[olist]
[*] Use 'Esc' to close all kind of menu screens
[*] Hotkey bugs that may interfere with the gameplay (b, q, r, c)
[*] Hotkeys updated to open Inventory (CTRL + B), Quest Logs (CTRL + Q), Relationship (CTRL + R), Character Info (CTRL + C)
[*] All food now show status value changes in the tooltips
[*] Save Screen that couldn't be closed once it's opened without actually saving now can be closed by pressing 'Esc'
[/olist]

Feel free to report any bugs that you find in the game so we can fix it for you!

Psst... A wiki is on the way!

Sincerely,
The Ninja Vault Team

notes.title: Parachronism: Order of Chaos is now Available on Steam
notes.content:
A new day is here!

Yes, that's right, there's a big news for everyone! [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1131430/Parachronism_Order_of_Chaos/]Parachronism: Order of Chaos[/url][/b] is now finally Released on Steam. It's been years since Parachronism has been developed and now it is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/a1097f8129077994d9683f80ddec301a81a8f719.png[/img]

The CURRENT release of Parachronism includes a great deal of features including Farming, Cooking, Mining, Combats, and Social systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/cd5283104d3161f9b0521d2e9a78ecec1e7ecb0d.png[/img]

There are lots of things in the terms "FARMING". You can buy soils, plant crops, collect animal products and more! And more and more updates are coming for this feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/b4efe834b78fcd2b95d60f282e6b8ce0745258ec.png[/img]

As you may have seen in the trailers, you can cook your own food! But well, you'll need to research the recipe first! But when you've known all the recipes you need, you can make the food whenever you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/c0d9bb19a8df5224d9fc596e2d913217b966b2f5.png[/img]

Alchemy, yes, collect herbs or just simply buy them and brew your potions. It could end up way cheaper than buying the end product. But if you've got lots of money then just buy the potion you need, the alchemist has got it all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/82b1b1e1e7d86060f2182b71d91b30c23e7feade.png[/img]

Buy clothing material or custom made costumes! You can change your costume and accessories. Plus, more costume and accessories are coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/45bfac010c84407011596fc6ce701a02e30efb13.png[/img]

Socialize with the locals and build a good relationship with them. But well, not all people are nice...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/2a043029d4563ba1c9464b85f61f4657f5cf6c52.png[/img]

Go to the cave and mine for valuable stones. Because, well... they look good and has high sell prices!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35556933/81bc8e3f7561ef8729e2f3c146c64c0edab83b49.png[/img]

Combats! Of course, it wouldn't really be an RPG game without combats. Be it just to train yourself or to finish tasks, you can find monsters all around you. Defeat enemies to level up and collect loot. Some of them may give really valuable items.

Lastly, have a bright day everyone!
